scope: Separate placement of ready-mixed concrete in a large strip-foundation pour; concrete supply, placement, consolidation, exposed-surface finishing, curing, applicable construction joint, equipment, delivery, quality control and records. Excavation, reinforcement and formwork are adjacent scopes and are excluded.

sources.authority: National Ready Mixed Concrete Association, CIP 31
sources.exactLocator: CIP 31, Ordering Ready Mixed Concrete, p. 2: order 4-10 percent above plan-dimension estimate for contingencies; the selected percentage remains project-specific.
КРЕР № 6, таблица 06-01-001, расценка 06-01-001-09, PDF page 18, измеритель 100 м³ железобетона в деле; глубинные вибраторы 26.6 маш.-ч на 100 м³.
Public preview pp. 1-2 and contents: consolidation, internal vibrators, procedure and quality control; equipment selection and productivity depend on the mixture and placing conditions.
Public preview pp. 1-4: materials, execution, initial and final curing, protection, QA and QC; the project selects and customizes the curing method.

sources.authority: Putzmeister, M33-4 truck-mounted concrete pump technical data
sources.exactLocator: Official M33-4 technical data: maximum theoretical output 160 m³/h. The preliminary site-utilization factor is separate, visible and replaceable; maximum theoretical output is not presented as achieved site productivity.

Official concrete standards index: C172 sampling, C143 slump, C1064 temperature, C31 field specimens and C39 compressive strength. Test frequency is supplied by the visible preliminary QA-lot value and must be replaced by the project quality plan when available.

sources.authority: Selected visible preliminary technology profile for the 150 m strip-foundation pour

selectedPreliminaryProfile.assumptionPolicy: Values described as assumptions are visible and editable in the same compact parameter row; replace them with project geometry, PPR, supplier schedule, selected-equipment passport and quality plan. They are not universal construction norms.
